method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Corporations Act 2001, Compilation No. 149, compilation date 19 September 2026, includes amendments to Act No. 87, 2026 (register id C2026C00432), as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/C2004A00818.txt; Corporations Regulations 2001 not deposited (the s 708(8)(c) amounts and any prescribed s 45A(2) figures are inputs)

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: From the seat of the founder-director and shareholder of a proprietary company: registration (ss 45A(2), 112, 113(1), 114, 117, 118, 201A), who is a director and the director ID (ss 9AC, 201B, 1272B, 1272C), directors' duties (ss 180-184) and s 191, offers without disclosure (s 708(1), (2), (3), (5), (8), (9), (11), (12)) and s 113(3), preference shares and dividends (ss 254A(2), 254T), share buy-backs (Part 2J.1 Division 2, ss 257A-257H with s 250MA), subsidiaries and the takeovers prohibition (ss 46, 50, 606), continuous disclosure (ss 674(2), 674A) and insider trading (ss 1042A, 1042C, 1042D, 1043A). Everything else in the seven volumes is out, including prospectus content and liability, the rest of s 708, capital reductions, insolvent trading, relevant interest and the s 611 exceptions, the insider trading exceptions, and penalties.
seat: the founder-director and shareholder of a proprietary company (Daniel)
